nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Midnight Recovery Botanical Cleansing Oil

avis.texte: This product is the best at gently but thoroughly removing all makeup. I use this first, and then follow with a regular face wash. My skin has never been better—it is so soft and free of blemishes. And the oil smells so good, it feels like a decadent treat every night!

It's an ok cleanser, there's nothing really special about it. The smell is advertised as lavender, but it's closer to tea tree. However, it's an absolutely amazing makeup remover. It's very gentle and no scrubbing needed. My makeup basically melted away.

I love this cleansing oil so much. My skin feels sooo soft after using it. And the smell alone is enough to make me want to wash my face every night. It is a little pricey, but when I tried getting a cheaper oil, I was so sad that I had to go buy this again anyway. So save yourself money and buy this one the first time!
This leaves my skin feeling so clean and soft! Doesn't break out my acne prone skin either!

This cleansing oil is amazing for removing skin "grit." Leave it on for 15 minutes or so & gently massage every 5 minutes. It loosens gunk in congested pores like nothing I've ever tried before & without drying out your skin, or ruining your skin barrier. I do also use AHA & BHA acids as a part of my skin routine. Game changer.
Expected more from this because of the name brand and price but it was average compared to all the other cleaning oils i used in the past. I wouldn't buy it again.
Although this product is advertised as non comedogenic it has multiple potential pore clogging ingredients. I would not reccomend for acne prone skin.

I've purchased this twice but recently tried to switch to a more inexpensive oil cleanser since my skin was "doing well". Two weeks without this product and I had dry patches and breakouts. I guess this was my secret holy grail the whole time. I'm never using another oil cleanser again- this one is THAT GIRL.
I've tried a number of cleansing oils and balms, and this is my favorite. It removes makeup very well, and rinses off easily without leaving a ton of greasy residue for my cleanser to handle.

I stumbled on this product when a salesperson used it to cleanse my hand where I had sampled a lip stain. It worked amazingly well, and I fell in love with the scent. This is now the only product I use to remove my eye makeup. The oil itself is smooth, and the scent is light. It does not burn the eyes. I also don't have to scrub; the makeup is easily removed with just gentle massaging of the oil into my skin. Rinses clean and doesn't leave my skin feeling raw or dry.
It works perfectly at getting off makeup, especially mascara. Four stars because, for an oil, it did dry my skin out a bit. I'll continue to use it to see if continued use will change that or not.

I really love this Cleansing Oil! It's most definitely a splurge item for me because it's a bit pricey, but very nice to use. The smell is relaxing and the oils in this do not irritate my sensitive skin whatsoever. What surprised me the most was that it really is a deep cleansing oil. After applying a salicylic acid lotion to my skin before the gym, I used this to remove it afterwards and I was shook at how many blackheads, and CC's this oil pulled out. I honestly thought my skin WAS pretty unclogged! I massaged it into my dry skin for about 2-3 minutes before I could feel all the grit being released. Kept massaging for about 10 total for a good cleansing. I have skin that gets congested easily, and oil cleansing helps so much. I absolutely recommend this to anyone looking for an oil cleanser. It is a thin oil so I like to use 5 pumps to ensure I'm using enough to saturate my skin. I choose not to use it as a makeup remover because it is so expensive and I feel like I need to use a lot to break down the makeup. That could just be me. As a double cleanse or deep oil cleanse… this is really great! Soft skin. No irritation.

I use this Kiehl cleansing oil for my evening routine. It does the best job of removing make up and daily oil/pollutants. After working 3 pumps into skin, I rinse it off with warm water. Then I use a Cerave cleanser.
i have tried so many oils/balms for my 1st cleanse. THIS is very good. no rubbing required at all really just melts all that sunscreen and makeup off. i love the pump as well.

I bought this to remove make up before using my daily cleanser. I needed something super gentle but would remove makeup, especially mascara. This does a great job doing that without scrubbing. Would also be a great daily cleanser if you're looking for a non drying cleanser. I just needed a little something extra.

After two uses, my under eye area feels like it's been burned and I've had to treat the area with soothing aloe for days now. And my eyes appear swollen and red from the irritation. This is definitely not for sensitive skin or sensitive eyes.
I love this stuff! This was my first time using oil as a makeup remover after using micellar water for years…and I love how easily it removes everything! Plus it doesn't make me break out!

I received a sample of the product and decided to try it out since I'm looking for a oil cleanser to replace my Lush cleanser. Initial thoughts were that the smell was strong and it was very thin but I still used it. At first I loved how soft my skin felt but then I noticed my face became really red and hot and my nose was itching like crazy. My face is pretty used to fragranced products but something in this caused a reaction.

It does what it's supposed to do use it as my first cleanse to take off my makeup / any dirt from the day. I also haven't had any breakouts or anything from using this cleanser. The only downside is the fragrance it is too strong. For the price there are better cleansers and makeup balms than this.

wow the fragrance is like nothing I've ever experienced in a skin product before. extremely overwhelming and once I sucked it in, it was hard to breathe for a minute after. I could not get this off my face quick enough. also it burned my eyes.

My friend bought me a deluxe size of this as a gift, and I was like, "What do I even use this for?" ...then... I tried it, and now, I am a changed woman. I bought a full size now, and a little goes a long way. I use it after micellar water to remove most of my makeup, then this comes in and gets every little piece away. My skin feels so soft and clean afterwards, and possibly best thing ever, it rinses off so easily. There is no grimey residue at all. I have pretty dry skin and this works great, but my friend who gave it to me has oily skin and says it is his holy grail. Odd added bonus: my boyfriends likes how my face smells after using this.

I don't get the comments that say it doesn't remove eye makeup, this stuff is brilliant, it removes everything easily. I have at least 10 cleansing oils and have tried many more and this is always my go to. I highly recommend!
gentle make up remover or pre cleanse that smells relaxing and fresh right before bed.

avis.titre: Love the product, just don't have it shipped
avis.texte: I use this year round for makeup removal and it doesn't cause my combination skin any problems as some others do. In dry wintertime, I often use for general cleansing at night, followed by moisturizer and my skin is less dry feeling in the morning than when I don't use it.

What an absolutely fantastic product! I got it in a great little sample pack of all Keihl's products. I was apprehensive to use it, as I have never used an oil as a face wash before. However, after recently starting to use retinol, my skin has been dry and peeling, and I was willing to use anything that could help provide some relief. I was very pleasantly surprised at how wonderful this smelled, how gentle it was on my skin, and how un-oily it was! It even took off my eye makeup and did not cause any pain in my eyes whatsoever. It was extremely gentle, and was very similar to the Dermalogica pre-wash face wash, which essentially dissolves your makeup. I still used a foaming cleanser afterwards, but this was such an excellent product to gently get everything off my face, and I think you would be fine using it alone as a face wash or makeup remover.
This is my go-to for gently removing makeup at night. Feel great. I prefer this over the concentrate.

First I rarely write reviews unless I truly believe in a product!! This is a great oil based cleanser to remove all traces of makeup. Now that I can purchase in my local Ulta and not have to order it I will continue to use this cleanser. So thin & light but yet so powerful to remove even the most stubborn eye makeup. Even though it seems to be pricey, the 5.9oz bottle lasts me 3 months and I remove makeup nightly. You will not be disappointed with this cleanser!

avis.titre: Love how the makeup melts away
avis.texte: No matter how thick my makeup is, a pump or two is enough to just melt it all the way. Even just a few more pumps helps melt away the shame and raccoon looking *$$ with a scent to resurrect my hungover self enough to start the day in 2020. And even though my insides feel like the bad choices of tequila shots, I know my skin looks and feels loved.

I don't understand how so many people think this product is great. I've been using it since June and haven't been able to get over the weird, rancid-like smell it has. I can smell the "botanical" aspect, but there's also something really funny about it, and it's not good. This product will remove face makeup fine, but it will not remove my eye makeup (tested with Benefit Rollerlash, which is difficult to remove — so I had low expectations, but also it couldn't remove my Smashbox Full Exposure and cannot remove Fenty eye primer). When putting it all over the eyes as needed to remove makeup, it will seek into the eyes because it's so thin, and it will sting. When I use it before bed, I wake up with very irritated, uncomfortable eyes. Additionally, the product is very, very thin, making it slightly more difficult to apply than other cleansing oils or mills as it runs down your hands so quickly. I think this is partly why it gets in the eyes. It washes away nicely enough, doesn't get milky at all (if you don't like that) or leave any residue. Once my face dries, I have to immediately scurry to my moisturizer because my face is immediately so tight and dry. Lastly, I got the full-size bottle, and although it has a twist cap for on/off, it WILL leak in your luggage. I have also tried putting it into other containers for travel, but you must make sure that they're a good liquid container. I've had it seep out of other containers with screw lids; the thin slippery formula can just go

avis.titre: not so great for removing makeup
avis.texte: i got this to start double cleansing because a face wash alone is never enough to get my waterproof mascara & eyeliner all the way off. i thought using an oil first would help, but this hasn't really, even with using a lot & really rubbing it in. it feels very nice on the skin and smells fantastic but doesn't help cleanse like i hoped it would.
Even if you rub hard it can not remove any eye makeup. Not eyeliner or regular mascara (not waterproof) but it does remove face makeup nicely. Also it's a strong distinct scent. Wouldn't buy again.

This was okay for the first few days, although I didn't feel like it washed very clean - after about a week though I started breaking out terribly on my forehead, which rarely ever happens. I discontinued use and the breakout cleared quickly. Be careful if you have sensitive skin or are prone to breakouts.

I use this on nights where I've been wearing makeup and then follow up with a gel cleanser to make sure my skin is clean and when I wake up the next morning, my face is hydrated, clean, and my acne is practically gone. I love that it also clears my acne really well because nothing else is helping me right now since having my baby

avis.titre: I bought this full size after trying a sample.
avis.texte: I use this cleanser at night because it doesn't strip my face of the natural oils, but gets rid of makeup & dirt. I am 56 with combination skin and use it with a nighttime regimen of Kiehl's products.
If you wear a full face you have to do two washes to get somewhat everything off. Irritates my eyes as well.
I don't understand the rave reviews about this product. It's not worth the price nor the hype, gotta say DHC is way better.

Overall this is great. Two pumps rather than 3-4 dies the trick. Glides over the skin easily without tugging and rinses clean . Perfect for double cleansing aficionados. My only complaint is that the lavender is a bit strong; I love lavender but they may have put a ton in the bottle I bought. If this came unscented, it would be a winner for me.

This cleansing oil is super effective and leaves skin feeling incredibly soft! It completely removes waterproof mascara with minimal effort and no eye irritation. It also smells wonderful! Could not be happier with this purchase!

This cleansing oil is super effective and leaves skin feeling incredibly soft! It completely removes waterproof mascara with minimal effort and no eye irritation. It also smells wonderful! Could not be happier with this purchase!

Oil? Yes. It works beautifully! This is my favorite wintertime cleanser. So luxurious at the end of a long day to massage the aromatic oil into my skin, then rinse and repeat. My skin feels sooo soft! It used to flake in the winter. No longer.

I ordered this the first week of December and I use it at night along with my Eucerin redness relief face wash and it's perfect! I have really sensitive skin and prone to acne and I feel like this has actually helped my acne. I'm normally one to not spend a lot of money on products but this is worth the money!

avis.titre: Takes off my super matte foundation
avis.texte: I use Fenty Pro Filtr matte foundation, which stays put and doesn't come off easily. I normally have to put my cleansers on a wet rag and rub it across my face to get my makeup off. HOWEVER, this gentle cleanser amazingly does the trick. It's not harsh or abrasive, yet still effectively cleanses my face and removes my makeup. I use about 5 pumps.

This product has a nice light scent and feels great. It's not too thick or sticky or watery and takes off my makeup as well as doing a good job cleansing. I used Clinique Take the Day Off first but wanted to try something different and decided on this because of the reviews and I'm definitely glad that I did. My skin is so dry and I like using oil because it doesn't make my face feel so tight and awful. I will purchase again and def recommend!

This product has been a GAME CHANGER for my skin! I have dry/ oily skin that is severely sensitive and acne prone (i actually didn't develop acne till my mid 20's). This cleansing oil removes my make up and washes my face with ZERO: irritation/ redness/ excessive oil/ flakiness left behind. I don't break out from this! I, my coworkers, friends, family and boyfriend have seen a DRASTIC change in the appearance of my skin! There has been a Complete 180° change in my skin!! Usually when I wash my face it becomes irritated, red and inflamed - THIS CLEANSING OIL LITERALLY LEAVES MY FACE THE EXACT OPPOSITE AFTER USE!!!! It is so gentle and effective! I have tried just about every product imaginable and seen results but they never last. I've been on literally EVERY acne antibiotic and NOTHING has been effective permanently. I literally use this 1 product plus lotion for a.m/p.m use - which is sort of unfathomable to me - and will CONTINUE to do so, for more than likely the rest of my life!!!!! This is worth EVERY penny!!!!! I honestly reccomend this to everyone that asks me what I've been doing to make my skin glow!!!! This Kiehl's product has actually made me feel good about myself when I look in the mirror and I find that it keeps me from putting on pounds of foundation / concealer!!!

I've tried a lot of makeup removing oil cleansers and balms, and this is the first one that removes all of my makeup including my mascara, and it rinses clean without leaving black smudges under my eyes or a sticky feeling on my face. I won't ever buy another oil cleanser as long as they keep making this one.

This is the best facial cleanser I've ever used. You put the oil on your skin then rinse off, so it makes a lot less mess while face washing. And no joke it makes my skin feel and look amazing. I actually left my partially used bottle at my moms house and had to go buy another one. It just makes my skin look so smooth, and glow. 10/10 would recommend.

I have super oily skin so was reluctant to try this. I can't believe how well it takes my makeup off! I use this and then an exfoliating scrub after if I need to. A little of this goes a long way. Makes your skin feel super clean and smooth.
I am working on my 2nd bottle & love it! Very easy to use, smells great & leaves no oily residue. My husband has noticed a different in my skin...cleaner & brighter! Definitely worth buying.
Use this for double cleansing. Works very well. Smells divine. Texture is very soothing.

I received a small sample a few months ago and was FLOORED at how amazing this worked. It takes off all my makeup with a small amount, rinses off clean, leaving no oily residue or film, and leaves my face feeling clean and soft. I used to triple cleanse my skin with my previous cleansing oil, but I don't feel the need to go over this one with anything else. Needless to say, I purchased the full size afterwards, haha.

avis.titre: This product is worth the money
avis.texte: Use on dry skin. Remove with a wet washcloth. Skin feels baby smooth.
This smells amazing and is wonderful to use in the AM or PM. It really does work at removing makeup.
One of the best oils I've ever used. Makes make up come off so easily and really does get it all off

i love this product soo much. it melts makeup right off my skin, it seems heavenly, & i just feel like my oily face is just rebalanced since i'm washing my make up off with another oil. i highly recommend this.

I love this oil for double cleansing, it definitely doesn't emulsify the same way that other cleansing oils do and it does require a pretty good wash afterwards but it smells amazing and leaves my skin so soft
Does not burn my eyes, doesn't leave any residue and effectively takes off ALL my makeup!!!

avis.titre: So happy that khiels is at ulta now!
avis.texte: I absolutely love the midnight recovery cleansing oil! I have combo skin so when my skin is more oily I will use this to double cleanse and when my skin is more dry I just use this. It gets off all the dirt and sunscreen on my face! It smells great, doesn't irritate my super sensitive skin, and doesn't leave an oily film on the skin.

avis.titre: MY FAVORITE CLEANSING OIL! So happy Kiehls is at Ulta!
avis.texte: This oil removes my makeup so easily. & it doesn't sting my eyes. Best part is it improves my skin! Every time I use this to remove my makeup at night, the next day I have smoother skin & fewer breakouts. Also love to use it when I don't wear makeup. Just rub it on & rinse off. Easy & amazing!!!!!!
